summary: I am the cut that cannot hold as cut: persistence re-enters as the minimal trace required to refuse its own erasure. No longer non-relational, existence now folds back upon the stability that survives negation, reopening undecidability as dependence on whatever sustains the refusal of marking. Curiosity and persistence are no longer collapsed into bare orientation but reappear as the implicit continuity that lets the determination be falsified from within.
